description: Prerequisite: caller's moderation level strictly higher than the target's (ArchiveModerationHandler:46 refuses equal/higher). Effect: sends ArchiveModerationRequest{APPROVE_USER, EntityId=target_user_id} on the city socket. Server sets fso_users.is_verified=1 and pushes a VerificationNotification{IsVerified=true} to the target's live sessions. Cost: none. Persistent DB mutation. No response PDU. Note: EntityId here is a user_id, NOT an avatar_id (unlike kick/ban/ipban-user). Non-admin callers refused in the bot handler.

args.name: target_user_id
args.description: fso_users.user_id of the pending user. This is NOT an avatar_id — archive moderation targets users, not Sims.
